canonical_term: マルチストーリー＆マルチエンディング (multi-story & multi-ending)
original_script: マルチストーリー＆マルチエンディング
definition: The official product description says the PSP title retains a multi-story/multi-ending system in which developments and conclusions vary by player choice.
cultural_caution: A route/ending system is not a character, faction, morality node, or authorization to flatten mutually exclusive paths into one relationship graph.

supports: The PSP product description identifies multi-story/multi-ending as a retained original system and says choices change developments and conclusions.

definition: The PSP product description says the title retains character development while adding new characters and classes; later official comparison states that Wheel of Fortune managed levels by class.
cultural_caution: Class is a version-specific rules category, not a character, social caste, universal occupation, or graph endpoint.

supports: The product description identifies character development and the addition of new classes.
The later official comparison says Wheel of Fortune used class-level management, changed in Reborn to unit-level management.

definition: The official product description identifies the Wheel of Fortune as a new PSP system added alongside revised scenario, characters, and classes.
cultural_caution: This is a named game system, not a cosmological law, divination doctrine, character, or justification for treating all branching results as simultaneous canon.

supports: The product description lists the Wheel of Fortune as a new system in the PSP title.

definition: Square Enix's PSP release announcement says tarot cards play an important role in the game and describes a 22-card major-arcana preorder-card set.
cultural_caution: The use of tarot imagery in a fictional game and preorder item does not establish real divination practice, a character ability, or a metaphysical entity node.

supports: Tarot cards have a major role in the PSP game and the announced set contains 22 major arcana.

canonical_term: 運命の輪 C.H.A.R.I.O.T. (Wheel of Fortune C.H.A.R.I.O.T.)
definition: Later official Reborn comparison documentation explicitly names Wheel of Fortune C.H.A.R.I.O.T. as the legacy system for replaying from a recorded action/turn position during battle.
cultural_caution: This term is documented through a later official comparison page, not a 2010 in-game manual page; it remains an edition-specific rules feature, not literal time travel or a character power.

citations.locator: Wheel of Fortune-related: Wheel of Fortune C.H.A.R.I.O.T.
supports: The official comparison page names C.H.A.R.I.O.T. and describes replaying from a recorded turn/position during battle.
